whatIs: Atropos is an open-source library for creating 3D parallax effects when hovering over an element, with layers that move at different depths. It works with plain JavaScript, has a React version, and a web component you can use in Angular, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and others. It weighs about 2 KB compressed and has no dependencies.
It's a good fit for cards, covers, or galleries you want to feel deep without adding a full 3D library.
uses: Adding depth to product or portfolio cards on hover.
Building a cover with illustration layers that shift with movement.
Making the same interaction work on touch screens, too.
caveats: It requires a fixed HTML structure of containers (atropos, atropos-scale, atropos-rotate, and atropos-inner) and loading its stylesheet.
The container needs a defined width and height in CSS, and each layer's depth is adjusted by hand with the data-atropos-offset attribute.
On touch devices you can use rotateTouch with scroll-x or scroll-y so the effect doesn't block page scrolling.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: Interfaces with cards or images that benefit from a light depth effect.
